exposure: International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Group (IADPSG) criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
Belgian French Language Gynecologists and Obstetricians Group (GGOLFB) criteria for GDM
outcome: Use of insulin therapy 21 months post-implementation of the IADPSG criteria
cohort: 393 patients diagnosed with GDM from January 2009 to December 2012
finding: The implementation of the new GGOLFB criteria for GDM significantly increased the incidence of GDM but did not significantly decrease large for gestational age or the number of cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean deliveries did not change significantly after the implementation of the new GGOLFB criteria for GDM.
